item.title: Apollo v4.0.0
item.description:
Apollo 4.0.0 | Apollo-Reborn-4.0.0
### Features
- Add **iPhone Duo** support with layouts that adapt to the closed display, open portrait, open landscape and partially folded positions, using the existing Apollo Reborn builds (#1245: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Browse a feed beside its comments, choose Original or Focused content widths, and open the subreddit list in a Standard or Liquid Glass panel - Inbox, Account and Settings gain sidebar/detail layouts in open landscape, while Search can keep results beside the page you open - Pixel Pals is unavailable on Duo; regular iPhones keep it - Add an optional **iPad Layout (Beta)** on iPadOS 18 and later, with a native sidebar, adjustable feed and reader columns, and full-width Gallery View (#1385: @jordanearle) - Try it from the one-time invitation or turn on iPad Layout under Interface; quit and reopen Apollo to apply it, or turn it off to return to the classic layout - Add **Restore Reading Session** to reopen your last feed, post and nearby reading position after iOS closes Apollo, including feed and comment sorting (#1441: @Thetromboneman1) - On by default under Media → Browsing; explicit links and notifications take priority, and turning it off deletes the saved session - Add a **Setup Assistant** for new installations to connect or restore, choose Classic, Balanced or Full Featured preferences, select appearance, and review before applying (#1401: @jordanearle) - Existing users can open it from Apollo Reborn settings with Keep My Settings selected; updating does not automatically apply a preset - Rework **Gallery View** with faster opening, pinch-to-resize tiles including a denser four-column layout, and native press-and-hold menus in the grid and fullscreen viewer (#1389, #1434: @icpryde, @IllIIllIllIllII) - Sports clips can play silently in the grid, newly visible tiles start reliably, and returning from a fullscreen image no longer leaves a black screen - Open **Gallery View** for All Saved or a selected **Saved category**, with empty categories shown without an endless spinner (#1440: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Rebuild **Recently Read** as a native Apollo feed that follows your post layout, thumbnails, text size, themes, swipe actions and menus (#1442: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Open it from its own row on your profile, switch its layout without changing other feeds, clear the history, or remove individual posts - Add **Recently Visited** subreddits to Search, with configurable section order and limits under Subreddits settings (#1404: @IllIIllIllIllII) - History clears on restart or account change and is not saved to backups - Add **Add Downvote Tap** under Posts & Feeds → Info Row so tapping a score can cycle through upvote, downvote and no vote; off by default (#1403: @AcornElf) - Add a **Subreddit Icon** switch to Compact and Immersive subreddit header layouts, updating the preview and live header together (#1426: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Feature seasonal icons in **Daily Spotlight** around holidays, including Apollo's original holiday icons; the spotlight now shows six picks (#1390, #1245: @icpryde, @IllIIllIllIllII) - Tint **Apollo Reborn maintainer usernames** purple in posts, comments and the Inbox, while retaining their real profiles and normal moderator indicators (#1411: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Make **Bug Reports** attach a removable debug log automatically, and mask usernames, account details, links and sensitive values before logs are exported or shared (#1422, #1423: @icpryde) - Export Debug Logs now shares a file that can be attached on GitHub; subreddit names, post/comment IDs and diagnostic details remain readable
### Performance
- Reduce unnecessary **API-Key-Free** requests by fetching subscriptions in larger pages and, with Reduce Rate Limiting on, batching feed avatars by page; interrupted subscription refreshes keep the existing list (#1416: @icpryde) - Deleted or unavailable Bluesky previews stop repeatedly fetching themselves and using Reddit requests as a fallback
### Fixes
- Refine **Duo navigation** with steadier feed positions and search bars when columns change, a smoother subreddit drawer, correct Home/Popular/All restoration, and Reddit links opened from Settings routed to Posts (#1470: @nnastasi) - Resume videos that were playing before folding or unfolding, covering both shared Reddit videos and direct-player media - Center **folded Duo title pills** in the usable header and keep composer text clear of the right-hand system strip, with correct wrapping and height through folding and unfolding (#1480: @jordanearle) - Keep the same **Duo comments thread** when returning from a linked subreddit after rotation or folding, and let the drawer return to an older retained feed correctly (#1464: @jordanearle) - Correct **Duo video autoplay** around the side rail and both columns' navigation bars (#1466: @kiliantyler) - Keep **View All Comments** visible inside its Duo comments pane when opening a specific comment (#1468: @d0lb33) - Stop the hidden **subreddit index** swallowing favorite taps and scrolling near the stars on Duo (#1469: @kiliantyler) - Open **native action menus** from controls moved into UIKit's overflow menu instead of silently dismissing without showing the actions (#1474: @kiliantyler) - Keep loading **API-Key-Free Inbox** rows when looking up a reply's quoted parent fails, showing the messages without that quote (#1455: @icpryde, @DeltAndy123) - Keep **API-Key-Free infinite scrolling** retryable after Reddit returns a rate limit or block page, rather than treating the refusal as the end of the feed (#1424: @icpryde) - Load the next feed page when **Hide Read** hides every loaded post, including with Infinite Scrolling off (#1412: @icpryde) - Fix **Reddit image uploads** becoming broken links when Imgur is selected, single-photo comment uploads failing, and synthetic album links in comments (#1402, #1406: @jordanearle, @IllIIllIllIllII) - Previously broken uploads still need to be uploaded again - Give **inline comment images and GIFs** Copy Image, Save Image and Share actions, and open loaded images fullscreen without a second loading fade (#1400: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Show the correct **image, GIF, video and album menus** when pressing and holding media inside a post, including Save All Media for albums (#1435: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Fix a crash when opening a **compact album** from its long-press preview (#1398: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Fix crashes while **feed videos** wait to play and while **deleted comments** are being prepared (#1428, #1450: @Thetromboneman1) - Keep a playing **feed video's sound and mute icon** in step when opening its post, including with the phone's silent switch on (#1425: @icpryde) - Stop **rich link cards** shifting the feed or changing their image crop after voting (#1457: @icpryde) - Open **Find in Comments** from the Liquid Glass post menu with its search field, keyboard and result navigation working correctly (#1446: @icpryde) - Keep a collapsed **feed search bar** hidden when returning from the fullscreen image viewer (#1447: @Thetromboneman1) - Bring back the complete **Liquid Glass tab bar** after swiping back from Edit Profile, including its glass background (#1431: @icpryde) - Refresh **subreddit icons and banners** from current Reddit artwork instead of retaining older images (#1396: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Preserve **usernames in comment and post headers** by shortening flair first, while keeping timestamps and other trailing details visible (#1366: @AcornElf) - Open **Reddit social links** on profiles directly in Apollo instead of the browser (#1407: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Explain why **Notifications settings** are unavailable when no notification backend is configured, instead of spinning forever (#1399: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Open **Poll, Media, Link and Text** post shortcuts in the correct editor even when the composer finishes preparing after its sheet appears (#1414: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Keep the separator below **Home's first post** visible after switchi…

item.title: TwitchAdBlock v31.7
item.description:
Twitch 31.7 | TwitchAdBlock 0.1.15
**TwitchMods v0.1.15**, for Twitch iOS **31.7**
### New: see what moderators delete Turn on **Keep Deleted Messages** in Settings → Emotes. When a moderator deletes a message, or times out or bans someone, their messages **stay in chat** instead of disappearing, and a short note like **"🛡 ronni was timed out for 10m"** shows up so you know what happened. - Want the notes to stand out? Turn on **Highlight Notes**, right under it, to give them a highlighted background. - Both are off by default. It only works for things that happen while you're in chat.
### New: hide the "From channels you follow" bar Turn on **Hide "From Channels You Follow"** in Settings → Home to remove the row of clips and recaps above the live channels on the Live page.
### Fixed - The **"Go Ad-Free"** button on the Following tab is hidden again. Twitch 31.7 rebuilt that tab, so the old way of hiding it stopped working.
Everything from v0.1.14 is still included: Twitch 31.7 support, ad-blocking, 7TV / BTTV / FFZ emotes (send them with the 7TV bar or by holding the emote button), Keep Live Feed Playing, Hide Stories and your default launch screen.
### Downloads - **`tv.twitch-31.7-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.15.ipa`**: the full app. - **`tv.twitch-31.7-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.15-noplugins.ipa`**: app extensions removed, so a free Apple ID only uses 1 App ID slot when sideloading.
Using the AltStore / SideStore / Feather source? You'll get this update automatically: ``` https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gunnerkidBT/TwitchAdBlock/master/apps.json ```
Full plain-language changelog: [`CHANGELOG.md`](https://github.com/gunnerkidBT/TwitchAdBlock/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md)

item.title: Mornye v5.2.6
item.description:
Mornye 5.2.6 | Mornye-v5.2.6-ios-unsigned
### New Features
- **library**: Sort songs and albums by file size - **desktop**: Add fullscreen and borderless window modes - **library**: List the files a scan could not read - **downloads**: Add custom folder path templates - **network**: Add Subsonic and OpenSubsonic support - **windows**: Prepare native ARM64 builds and packages - **player**: Color the current track row from its artwork - **desktop**: Open the mini player on Windows and Linux
### Bug Fixes
- **desktop**: List full screen and borderless shortcuts - **automix**: Verify beat alignment and hold phase through the mix - **home**: Keep explore artwork square - **flutter**: Backport semantics geometry crash fix - **tags**: Support ID3-prefixed FLAC metadata writes - **library**: Keep playlists accessible without local songs - **conversion**: Preserve quoted paths in lossy exports - **library**: Index songs whose tags fail to parse - **playback**: Allow MP3 playback with malformed ID3 tags - **automix**: Start the next song on the outgoing beat - **desktop**: Keep artist album selection and scroll position - **android**: Refresh media controls when track metadata changes - **windows**: Use the MSVC coroutine deprecation macro's real name - **windows**: Install the libmpv license and build on MSVC 14.5x - **library**: Keep liked local tracks visible during cover fades - **windows**: Support UNC library paths and network downloads - **desktop**: Restore private file access after cache removal - **notifications**: Handle Linux launch callbacks and contain queue alerts - **repo**: Move the store button under the text on narrow rows - **library**: Simplify duplicate review rows and expose load errors - **settings**: Keep final controls clear of floating playback bars - **home**: Collapse the empty prompt after installing an extension - **library**: Emphasize Play in collection header actions - **library**: Read tagless audio without losing document names - **desktop**: Wrap search and store category filters - **desktop**: Add scroll arrows to artist and recent shelves - **settings**: Restore 5.2.1 card contrast - **network**: Flush and verify SMB uploads before publishing - **android**: Resolve SAF audio paths when saving lyrics - **desktop**: Handle missing initial download folders
### Refactoring
- **onboarding**: Remove the rebrand introduction tour
### Testing
- **library**: Expect the sort sheet to scroll at its cap - **player**: Cover mini player metadata refresh and session restore
### Chores
- Update AltStore source to v5.2.5 by [@github-actions[bot]](https://github.com/github-actions[bot]) - Bump version to 5.2.6 (165) - **license**: Adopt LGPL-3.0-only for Mornye
**Full Changelog**: [v5.2.5...v5.2.6](https://github.com/mornyeapp/Mornye/compare/v5.2.5...v5.2.6)
---
### Downloads
#### Android - **arm64**: `Mornye-v5.2.6-arm64.apk` (recommended for modern devices) - **arm32**: `Mornye-v5.2.6-arm32.apk` (older devices) - `*.apk.idsig`: V4 signatures for `adb install --incremental` only; normal installs do not need them
#### iOS - **iOS**: `Mornye-v5.2.6-ios-unsigned.ipa` (sideload required)
`SHA256SUMS.txt` lists the SHA-256 of every file above.
### Installation **Android**: Enable "Install from unknown sources" and install the APK **iOS**: Use AltStore, Sideloadly, or similar tools to sideload the IPA

item.title: Mornye v5.2.1
item.description:
Mornye 5.2.1 | Mornye-v5.2.1-ios-unsigned
### New Features
- **onboarding**: Replace the 5.2 tour with a rebrand tour - **branding**: Use Mornye Ink for the iOS launch screen - **branding**: Adopt the Mornye logo across the app - **branding**: Rename app and native backend to Mornye - **player**: Swipe up on the mini player to open Now Playing - **playback**: Add normalization pre-amp and track or album gain - **ui**: Align Material screens with M3 Expressive guidance
### Bug Fixes
- **crash**: Reduce repeated notices and retain diagnostics - **player**: Prefer embedded art for local files over online covers - **startup**: Wait for the Activity before backend startup calls - **library**: Use path index for network scan cache lookups - **ui**: Align Material screens with the design guide - **concerts**: Give the Material concert page a Material layout - **player**: Refresh late duration updates without reopening - **home**: Match On repeat tracks to their Library entry - **home**: Show listening sections on the Mornye Home without a feed - **lyrics**: Ease synced line changes with a spring scroll - **haptics**: Render music pulses on basic motors and add tuning sliders - **downloads**: Embed enriched artwork across audio formats - **artwork**: Read padded ID3 covers and repair cached previews - **crash**: Exclude system memory kills from crash notices - **backup**: Reconcile restored iOS paths before publishing history - **library**: Release network scan memory and cancel active metadata reads - **android**: Apply renderer compatibility before shared engine creation
### Performance
- **ui**: Improve Material and Mornye player and library smoothness - **library**: Cache unchanged SMB and WebDAV scan metadata
### Documentation
- **readme**: Remove Related Projects section - **readme**: Drop heading anchors from feature cards
### Chores
- Update AltStore source to v5.2.0 by [@github-actions[bot]](https://github.com/github-actions[bot]) - **branding**: Drop remaining SpotiFLAC references - **release**: Bump app to 5.2.1 build 163
**Full Changelog**: [v5.2.0...v5.2.1](https://github.com/mornyeapp/Mornye/compare/v5.2.0...v5.2.1)
---
### Downloads
#### Android - **arm64**: `Mornye-v5.2.1-arm64.apk` (recommended for modern devices) - **arm32**: `Mornye-v5.2.1-arm32.apk` (older devices) - `*.apk.idsig`: V4 signatures for `adb install --incremental` only; normal installs do not need them
#### iOS - **iOS**: `Mornye-v5.2.1-ios-unsigned.ipa` (sideload required)
### Installation **Android**: Enable "Install from unknown sources" and install the APK **iOS**: Use AltStore, Sideloadly, or similar tools to sideload the IPA

item.title: Eclipse v2.3.0
item.description:
Eclipse 2.3.0 | Eclipse-unsigned-v2.3.0-20261020-090254
Additions:
-Deep tracker library integration option (AniList, MAL, Trakt) -Simkl Tracking (Will NOT get deep tracking integration due to free tier limits) -Ratings and Notes setting -Concurrent download controls -Background HLS downloading (iOS 26+ only) -Subtitle delay -Dolby Atmos and Dolby Vision support -epub support (experimental) -Light novel reader rework
Fixes/Changes (fixes are not guaranteed, different devices behave differently) :
-Fixed mpv backgrounding audio desync, it should take a sec to recover. -Fixed mpv downstream blowing up -Changed Alt poster and season building to be more accurate, tested 220 anime, and 100 western shows -Fixed unaired episode hiding -Fixed System calendar crash, app now enforces Gregorian calendar -Fixed Ratings and Notes getting lost -Removed Performance mode and watch together. No longer needed/wasn't popular. Perf mode is enforced On -Ratings and notes can now be assigned per season rather than the whole show -Subtitle edit fixes -Language filters are now hardcoded values instead of user inputted ones -Fixed Reader mode library importing not being able to connect a source -Rearranged settings to push more important ones higher -Changed some Auto Mode logic -Fixed audio name detection -Fixed subtitle name detection -Double tap to seek no longer brings up the player UI
As always, use GitHub issues or the discord for requests or bug reports.

item.title: Mornye v5.2.0
item.description:
Mornye 5.2.0 | SpotiFLAC-v5.2.0-ios-unsigned
### New Features
- **crash**: Show persistent crash reports on Home - **about**: Link the lyrics website and service status - **player**: Search lyrics online for files without them - **lyrics**: Add lrc.red and BetterLyrics, split SpotiFLAC-Mobile Lyrics - **home**: Greet in the header and gather listening shortcuts - **onboarding**: Introduce the 5.2 release tour - **library**: Add adaptive icons to collection tabs - **home**: Localize greetings and address profile names - **home**: Expose extension country settings and isolate regional caches - **lyrics**: Refresh quote sharing and load lyrics on demand - **android**: Refresh launcher widgets with adaptive expressive layouts - **player**: Add configurable full-screen cover art - **player**: Synchronize music haptics with local playback - **lyrics**: Share lyric cards and refine timed vocal transitions - **player**: Show audio source processing and output details - **equalizer**: Add multiband EQ and per-player native audio processing - **autoplay**: Enable personalization by default and confirm learning resets - **a11y**: Label controls and improve settings contrast and targets - **i18n**: Add player feature text and clarify built-in playback - **loading**: Align skeletons with collection and extension layouts - **player**: Share volume controls across Material and Mornye - **rewind**: Add yearly highlights and seasonal library banners - **forms**: Adopt expressive inputs with consistent form state - **ui**: Add themed menus and adaptive checkbox rows - **ui**: Unify content cards and preserve press behavior - **layout**: Adapt tablet navigation and center wide content - **listening**: Show a skeleton while statistics load - **listening**: Add Rewind highlights and refresh statistics - **player**: Refine mini-player and queue feedback - **library**: Add sectioned browsing and adaptive fast scrolling - **material**: Unify progress and surface transitions - **material**: Animate header action groups and collapse - **settings**: Connect custom Material settings rows - **settings**: Connect standard Material settings rows - **ui**: Add Material Expressive spring motion - **lyrics**: Add SpotiFLAC fallback for Apple Music outages - **ui**: Extend Material Expressive surfaces and playback controls - **theme**: Show a check on selected expressive switches - **theme**: Adopt Material Symbols and expressive components - **metadata**: Add per-field download tag separators
### Bug Fixes
- **crash**: Match the Home crash card to the error card style - **library**: Recover interrupted scans and stale notifications - **downloads**: Offer folder recovery for permission failures - **equalizer**: Keep headroom and limiter choices when applying a preset - **lyrics**: Restore QQ Music search after the desktop CGI broke - **player**: Restore the lighter full-screen cover scrim - **storage**: Retain legacy Android cipher migration support - **library**: Recover missing local album artwork from audio - **library**: Restore bit depth as the default quality badge - **haptics**: Analyze document audio across skips and AutoMix - **player**: Report Android output failures without skipping tracks - **network**: Request Android 17 local network access before NAS connections - **theme**: Retain dominant cover colors in player backgrounds - **automix**: Align effect handoffs and render sufficient source audio - **downloads**: Recover native queues when their service dies - **verification**: Bound browser handoffs and release expired dialogs - **player**: Size volume slider handle proportionally - **settings**: Use shared sheet for log level selection - **headers**: Fit artwork and unify toolbar controls - **metadata**: Align separator picker with Settings components - **settings**: Unify adaptive sheet layout and drag behavior - **player**: Expose favorites and shuffle in Material notifications - **audio**: Preserve FLAC precision in Android bit-perfect playback - **extensions**: Use adaptive icons for installed extension avatars - **library**: Align filter and sort sheet sizing and dismissal - **player**: Prevent overlapping titles during rapid skips - **storage**: Preserve audio MIME when publishing SAF downloads - **lyrics**: Refresh LRC sidecars in their actual SAF folder - **download**: Probe M4A streams before preserving requested FLAC - **automix**: Wait for advancing audio before starting fades
### Performance
- **lyrics**: Compile credit regexes once - **library**: Build DateFormat and RegExp once instead of per row - **history**: Suppress unchanged membership notifications - **history**: Reuse unchanged download lookup indexes - **releases**: Narrow weekly release provider dependencies - **lyrics**: Cache timed lyric segment geometry - **player**: Cache adjacent track titles during swipes
### Refactoring
- **android**: Share the SAF scan percent and CUE helpers - **android**: Move SAF batch exists and modtime queries out of MainActivitySafScan.kt - **android**: Move SAF tree listing and executors out of MainActivitySafScan.kt - **android**: Move SAF CUE helpers out of MainActivitySafScan.kt - **android**: Move SAF scan checkpointing out of MainActivitySafScan.kt - **android**: Move SAF file inspection out of MainActivitySafScan.kt - **android**: Put the SAF IO helpers on Context receivers - **android**: Share the foreground wake lock and start helper between the two services - **providers**: Share one Coalescer for single-flight request coalescing - **android**: Move the lifecycle backend calls into MainActivityLifecycleCalls.kt - **android**: Move the download service and worker backend calls into MainActivityServiceCalls.kt - **android**: Move the library scan backend calls into MainActivityLibraryScanCalls.kt - **android**: Move the metadata and tag backend calls into MainActivityMetadataCalls.kt - **android**: Move the SAF backend calls into MainActivitySafCalls.kt - **android**: Move install state, extension intents, SAF leases and small channels out of MainActivity.kt - **library**: Split local_library_provider.dart into source, scan and cover parts - **library**: Share the scan completion tail as _finishScan - **library**: Remove the unreachable snapshot sub-branch of the incremental scan - **convert**: Route single-track conversion through the shared pipeline - **queue**: Move the completion bridge into CompletionBridgeTracker - **queue**: Move library paging state into QueueLibraryPager - **bridge**: Share one generic cache entry and put/prune helper - **collections**: Move playlist cover file I/O into PlaylistCoverStore - **cache**: Move directory scanning and clearing into CacheMaintenanceService - **analysis**: Move the FFmpeg runner out of the widget - **analysis**: Move the analysis disk cache into audio_analysis_cache.dart - **analysis**: Move the pure FFmpeg builders and parsers to a service - **setup**: Move SharedPreferences access behind SetupProgressStore and SafMigrationPromptStore - **providers**: Move UI-declared providers to lib/providers - **rust**: Rename mod.rs modules to the foo.rs + foo/ layout - **concerts**: Move the calendar channel into a service - **repo**: Prepare install paths in the repo notifier - **share**: Share the widget capture helper - **extensions**: Share the extension health color and icon helpers - **playlists**: Share the playlist name prompt and dispose its controller - **artist**: Move the discography download into a part - **home**: Use downloadSingleTrack for search results - **storage**: Share the SAF download tree pick - **layout**: Share responsiveScale and effectiveTextScale - **layering**: Move logic files out of screens - **layering**: Move model files to models and fix inverted imports - **layering**: Move UI action helpers from services and utils to controllers - **core**: Add fs::write_atomic and use it for the atomic file writes - **rust**: Consolidate small duplicate helpers - **core**: Move the lenient Go-style JSON decoder to core::json - **me…
